description: Main Flutter application source file for a Tic Tac Toe game, including UI setup, game logic, and state management.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp

classes.name: TicTacToeHomePage
classes.description: Main page widget managing game state, UI interactions, and layout.

classes.name: _TicTacToeHomePageState
classes.description: State class for managing game logic, player turns, game resets, and UI updates.
